interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.59.0 selectively adapts three Python stdlib-only artifact-governance and verification patterns from openai/math (Apache-2.0): adds the opt-in read-only note withdrawal & supersession lifecycle auditor (skills/agentic-vault/scripts/vault_lifecycle.py, docs/note-lifecycle.md; validating withdrawn_reason, pinned 40/64-hex withdrawn_revision, superseded_by targets/cycles, proof_or_evidence_only withdrawal scope, active stale-citation warnings, and bounded transitive cascade dependents; also extending default vault_healthcheck.py status enum with withdrawn and superseded), adds opt-in review_status ('unchecked' default vs 'independent_reviewed'), automation_methods, pinned immutable spec_files vs disjoint solution_files separation, and explicit permitted_gaps allowlists to vault_coverage.py, and adds check_exact_tree_membership() (rejecting missing/extra files, directories, and symlinks plus enforcing required zero-count negative-evidence files) and --require-independent-review to scripts/verify_release_claims.py. Retained from v0.58.0: SessionStart and vault_doctor hidden markup injection sanitization, Holm-Bonferroni & PPI++ evaluation stats, deterministic refusal recovery guidance, 14 commands, 15 Antigravity CLI skills, and 1 Codex required skill. No new runtime dependencies; Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. The seven certificate-bound checker files remain byte-identical from v0.55.0 through v0.59.0; when upgrading from v0.54.1 or earlier where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
